name: Diyaluma Falls
description: Diyaluma Falls, a block of water cascading in Badulla District, Sri Lanka, offers visitors a serene spot for swimming, picnicking, and nature walks. The falls are a natural attraction, known to have been formed by the erosion of the ancient Sinharaja Forest Reserve. Locals believe the name Diyaluma means "sacred water" in Sinhala, reflecting its importance in the local culture. Historically, the area was also significant as part of the ancient trade routes connecting different parts of the island. Today, it remains a popular destination for both locals and tourists seeking a refreshing escape amidst lush greenery.
monsoon_note: High flow and dangerous during NE monsoon (Oct-Jan). Caution advised.

name: Rawana Falls

name: Dunhinda Falls

Known for its tranquility and scenic beauty, Dunhinda Falls has become a popular spot for both locals and tourists seeking a moment of peace in the midst of nature.

name: Bogoda Falls

name: Diyathalawa Falls

name: Girandurukotte Falls
